note: Eleven distinct modes of travel across seventeen days. Counts are taken from the booking sheet, not from memory.

modes.name: Uber
modes.blurb: The one o'clock cab from Cleo County that started everything, the run from Oslo S down to Sørengkaia, and the 180-krone cab up from Trondheim port because there had already been enough walking.

modes.name: Aircraft
modes.where: Delhi · Istanbul · Oslo · Trondheim · Tromsø · Rovaniemi · Stockholm · Baku
modes.blurb: IndiGo, Turkish, SAS twice, Finnair, Pegasus, and Azerbaijan Airlines twice. Six airlines, four of which she had never flown before.

modes.name: Airport train
modes.blurb: Twenty-three minutes from the runway into the middle of Oslo, and already covered by the Oslo Pass bought at the other end.

modes.name: Bergen Railway
modes.blurb: 08:25 to 13:04, over the Hardangervidda. The line climbs out of the city and does not really come down again until the coast.

modes.name: Flåm Railway
modes.blurb: Fifty minutes, twenty tunnels, and a gradient that should not work without a rack. One of the steepest adhesion railways in the world, and the reason people come to Myrdal at all.

modes.name: Fjord ferry
modes.blurb: Through the Nærøyfjord, which is on the UNESCO list and is two kilometres wide at its narrowest with walls twelve hundred metres high.

modes.name: Coach
modes.blurb: Up the hairpins out of the fjord in the dark, arriving in Bergen at 19:25.

modes.name: Coastal ship
modes.blurb: Havila, reference 401377. Florø at 02:45, Måløy at 05:15, Torvik at 08:20, a whole day in Ålesund, Molde at 22:35, Kristiansund at 02:45. The working coast, on its own timetable.

modes.name: City bus
modes.blurb: The Vy buses from Bergen busstasjon out to Torborg Nedreaas' gate, and the FB73 from Solsiden at five in the morning to catch the flight north.

modes.name: Santa Claus Express
modes.blurb: The overnight VR sleeper, 17:52 to 07:33, down the entire length of Finland while asleep. It is a train. It has always been a train.

modes.name: Baltic ferry
modes.blurb: Sailed at 20:55, docked at 06:30, through the archipelago in the dark both ends.
